Definition: perhaps by transposition from G2048 (through the idea of stillness); tranquil:--quiet.
BiblicalUsage: Ḗremos means quiet — at rest, still, peaceable. It occurs just once, where Paul tells Timothy to pray for kings and all in authority, that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life. The word is the goal of the praying: a life at rest.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that ḗremos is the picture of the life prayer aims at: quiet, peaceable, and godly, not anxious and loud.
